purpose: Prepare secret-safe RPC authentication, read-only Core consumer observability, isolated Gateway runtime modes, production-control requirements, and Maintenance Runbook V6 without entering the cutover.
allowed_operations: implement project-local credential-provider interfaces that never persist or print a token
add offline and production-preflight runtime isolation with production fail-closed guard
add a read-only Core Feishu runtime observer
add offline unit, Pester, schema, and secret-leak tests
perform read-only runtime and production-control availability audits
publish sanitized 035 reports and Runbook V6
prohibited_actions: start or restart the production Project Gateway
send a real Feishu message, attachment, or card
modify production Binding, Agent, Cron, OAuth, model, OpenClaw core, or PROJECT_STATUS.yaml
write credentials to command lines, logs, reports, source, Git, or plaintext configuration
commit, push, tag, mark P0_READY, or advance to P1
hard_gates: missing or rejected RPC credentials keep ready=false
unknown Core consumer state remains fail-closed
offline mode must not access credentials or network transports
production mode must remain guarded until a real Feishu transport and explicit maintenance execution are available
no production control call is permitted in task 035
secrets: Only provider names, booleans, redacted statuses, hashes, counts, and timestamps may be persisted.
